title: Cursor adapter
description: Paste-ready user rules file (core rules inline), five subagents in ~/.cursor/agents unless Claude Code or Codex agents are installed, CLI commit/PR attribution off only where unset. Skills come from ~/.agents/skills.
postInstall: Cursor: user rules exist only in the app (Customize > Rules), so paste the contents of ~/.cursor/llm-config/user-rules.md there yourself; nothing is applied automatically. Cursor reads subagents from ~/.cursor/agents, ~/.claude/agents and ~/.codex/agents, so the Cursor copies are installed only when neither Claude Code nor Codex is selected. Skills: ~/.agents/skills, plus ~/.claude/skills and ~/.codex/skills if present, which can duplicate names. cli-config.json gets attribution.attributeCommitsToAgent and attributePRsToAgent = false only where those keys are absent; if you already set them to true they stay true, so change them yourself to drop the 'Made with Cursor' trailer and footer. No hooks are installed; see components/cursor/HOOKS.md.
